spec.prompt: Inside the Voskhod-2 capsule: the cosmonaut Alexei Leonov (face and suit exactly as in the first two reference images), gloves off, sketches on a small sheet of white paper pressed against his knee with a colored pencil. A bundle of colored pencils floats weightless around his wrist, each tied to a string on his wrist. On the paper: the curve of the Earth and a band of colors, the sunrise. Warm light from a porthole. Close-up of his hand and the paper, then a slow tilt up to his absorbed face. Photorealistic, shot on 35mm film, IMAX documentary realism in the spirit of Apollo 11 (2019) and Gravity. Accurate 1965 Soviet hardware: the white Berkut spacesuit with rust-orange harness straps, a white helmet with red CCCP letters above the visor, Soviet markings only. Hard directional sunlight, deep black space, crisp silhouettes. No on-screen text, no captions.
